author: resepignev
body:
Heey resepignev here,

I was working on a YML for a friend here on Avicus and I had to look in the YAML docs of Avicus. I saw two "new" flags. First the "PROJECTILE_DAMAGE" and the "ARROW_KNOCKBACK"-flag. I never saw them before, maybe because I'm not often using the YAML docs.

Now to my Questions:
"What does they do?"
"How can I use them?"
"Does they need triggers or so on?"

And I have another little Question to the whole YML.
Let's say a cobblestone block is in the inventory and has the knockback enchantment and you place the block, then you mine an other cobblestone block (not the same). Will all cobblestone blocks has this "knockback" enchantment?
